title: File:View of the coast of Puerto Vallarta.jpg
desc: View of the coast of Puerto Vallarta, Mexico as our snorkel excursion boat heads to our snorkel site off the coast of the Marietas Islands. A rigid inflatable boat (sometimes referred to as a "Zodiac") can be seen carrying another group of tourists exploring the area's sights.
